title: viola tricolor var. subatlantica
intro: Viola tricolor var. subatlantica, commonly known as the Pansy or Heartsease, is a flowering plant that belongs to the viola genus. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce inflammation, and alleviate anxiety due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Viola tricolor var. subatlantica include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and nervine properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
